page.notes: The Hebrew forms are mostly damaged by ink spread and show-through, and their vowel points cannot be read reliably, so most Hebrew words are marked [?] or left as [?] placeholders. The Latin glosses and abbreviations are legible. The word after "planeta" and the word "rostrilabrum" are doubtful. The letter heading "מ ח" is set centred and is kept as a paragraph because it is a bare letter. The line ending "ejus," is the catchword. The running head is not transcribed because it is a Hebrew letter pair that cannot be read reliably.
